name: Shamrock Stitch
description: Irish-designed performance apparel for motorsport athletes.
story: Shamrock Stitch was founded by a former rally driver who saw a need for better quality, more durable racing apparel. We are passionate about supporting up-and-coming talent in motorsport and want to partner with teams who embody the spirit of Irish innovation and determination. We seek a partnership that will showcase our apparel's performance in demanding racing environments.
